package.name: safety_monitor
package.description: ROS-free core of a whole-robot proximity monitor: a sphere model of the robot, distance queries to static primitives, a voxel ESDF and moving capsules (a person proxy), self-distance between non-allowed sphere pairs, and a speed-and-separation speed scale with a latched protective stop that fails safe on stale or invalid input. NOT A CERTIFIED SAFETY FUNCTION: it only slows the robot earlier; see the README. The core is Eigen and yaml-cpp only (no ROS, no clock); the opt-in safety_chain_node is the only ROS part.
